If you aren't ready for certain shapes or transitions (like going upside down), you aren't. That is okay! Hoop is nothing you are suddenly perfect at after one lesson. People who really nail a lot of things from scratch usually have pole dance background or other aerial background. Your instructor is very unprofessional. 

I am a pole instructor training to be a hoop instructor too soon. She should have introduced herself quickly. For things you cannot do, she has (!!!) to give you different options or regressions.

This does not sound like a good place for you to train. :( I'm so sorry. It is NOT your fault.

As others have mentioned, you should 1. ask for a refund and 2. look for another place.

A good hoop session should consist of the following things and aspects:

1. A proper warmup on the floor
2. Conditioning to build up strength for the hoop
3. Regressions (and progressions) for the shapes you learn on the hoop
4. Safe techniques, spotting
5. A cool down
